class CNF:
    def __init__(self):
        self.num_vars = 0
        self.clauses = []

    def new_var(self):
        self.num_vars += 1
        return self.num_vars

    def add_clause(self, clause):
        self.clauses.append(list(clause))

    def xor(self, a, b):
        z = self.new_var()
        self.add_clause([a, b, -z])
        self.add_clause([a, -b, z])
        self.add_clause([-a, b, z])
        self.add_clause([-a, -b, -z])
        return z

    def and_(self, a, b):
        z = self.new_var()
        self.add_clause([-a, -b, z])
        self.add_clause([a, -z])
        self.add_clause([b, -z])
        return z

        z = self.new_var()
        self.add_clause([-z, a, b])
        self.add_clause([-a, z])
        self.add_clause([-b, z])
        return z

        s = self.xor(t, cin)
        u = self.and_(a, b)
        v = self.and_(t, cin)
        cout = self.or_(u, v)

        clauses.append([a, b, -z])

        clauses.append([-a, b, z])
